entry.title: Youth unemployment eases slightly to 47.3% as overall unemployment rises to 33.7% in the third quarter of 2026
entry.summary:
Izinga elisemthethweni lokungasebenzi linyuke ngamaphuzu ayizinkomba angu-0.1 laya ku-33.7% ekotheni yesithathu ka-2026, njengoba ukuqashwa kukhulile ngabantu abangu-101,000 kwaba yizigidi ezingu-16.8, kodwa abasebenzi babakhulu ngesivinini esikhudlwana. Ukungasebenzi kwentsha (iminyaka 15 kuya ku-34) kwehle ngamaphuzu angu-0.1 kwaya ku-47.3%: intsha engasebenzi yehla ngo-23,000 yaya ezigidini ezingu-5.0, kanti intsha eqashiwe yehla ngo-5,000 yaya ezigidini ezingu-5.5.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Leli yinani iqembu elilisebenzisayo kwizindlela zabathweswe iziqu nezinguquko ezinobulungiswa. Isigxobo 4 sibuza ukuthi i-AI inciphisa noma yandisa lesi sikhala kuleli qembu ngqo.

Statistics South Africa · National statistics office

entry.title: University AI policies focus on cheating but leave data risks largely unaddressed, commentary warns
entry.summary:
Umbono okuphawulwayo okukwi-University World News uthi amanyuvesi abhalile imithetho eyinqabile emelene nokukhwabanisa okusizwa yi-AI, kodwa ashiya iziqondiso ezincane kakhulu mayelana nendlela abasebenzi nabacwaningi abangathela ngayo idatha yesikhungo, yabafundi noma yocwaningo kuma-thuluzi e-AI. Ikhombisa ucwaningo lwase-UK lapho u-63% wezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezingu-49 zase zisebenzisa ithuluzi le-AI, kodwa u-37% kuphela owawuhlole izingozi ngaphezu komhlinzeki waso oseduze, ikhombe nokuvuza kwedatha e-University of Osaka okuthinte abantu abangu-77,851 njengesikhumbuzo sokuthi ingozi enkudlwana ivamise ukuba yiphutha lejwayelekile ledatha, hhayi imodeli ye-AI uqobo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesigxobo 6, mayelana ne-AI enesibopho, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, lokhu kuyisikhuthazo sokuhlola ukuthi ukuphathwa kwe-AI emanyuvesi, kuhlanganise nelo leqembu uqobo, likwembula ukuphathwa kwedatha, hhayi ubuqotho bezemfundo kuphela.

University World News · Established higher education press (commentary)

entry.title: Wits opens a Global Higher Education Futures Centre, with a dedicated generative AI pedagogy hub
entry.summary:
I-University of the Witwatersrand (Wits) isivule ngokusemthethweni i-Global Higher Education Futures Centre, eyasungulwa ngesinyathelo se-webinar yokuqala ngomhla ka-30 Septhemba eyaheha abafundisi, abaholi bezikhungo kanye nabenzi benqubomgomo abangaphezu kuka-170. Lesi sikhungo sakhelwe izinsika eziyisishiyagalolunye, kuhlanganise nenye egxile ekufundiseni nge-AI ekhiqizayo. Abasunguli baso bachaza lesi sinyathelo njengempendulo kulokho abakubiza ngokuthi bungxushunxuswa oluhlanganisa ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukungqubuzana kwepolitiki yamazwe, ukuphazamiseka okubangelwa i-AI ekhiqizayo, nokungalingani e-Afrika esezansi kweSahara nakwamanye amazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba. UMsunguli waso, uSolwazi Ruksana Osman, kanye noMqondisi, uDkt Bernadette Johnson, bathi lesi sikhungo sizogxila ekukhiqizweni kolwazi lwamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba, kunokuthi athathe amamodeli asezilungiselelwe avela eNyakatho.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika 6, leli yunivesithi laseNingizimu Afrika liyakha uhlaka lwalo oluqondile lokucabanga mayelana nokuphazanyiswa kwemfundo ephakeme yi-AI, kunokuba lithathe elakhelwe kwenye indawo, okuyindlela kanye okuholwa ngayo amazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba, egxile ekulinganeni, eyimigomo kanye nenjongo u-Wits AHEAD osekelwe ngayo.

University of the Witwatersrand · University announcement

entry.title: Wording of university generative AI policies shapes how students and teachers actually behave, study finds
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi bahlaziya izinqubomgomo ze-AI ekhiqizayo kuma-yunivesithi ayi-101 e-United States, futhi baxoxa nabafundi abangama-20 kanye nothisha abangama-20 mayelana nendlela imithetho elandelwa ngayo ngempela. Bathola ukuthi indlela umthetho ubhalwe ngayo, hhayi kuphela okuqukethwe kuwona, iguqula indlela abafundi abaziphatha ngayo: umthetho ogxile ekungathembekeni wenza abafundi bafihle ukusetshenziswa kwabo kwe-AI ngenxa yokwesaba, kuyilapho umthetho ogxile ekuzibophezeleni ukhuthaza ukuvuleleka. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, othisha bathi sebethwele umsebenzi owengeziwe wokuqinisekisa, kodwa bengenayo indlela eqinisekile yokuhlola ukuthi abafundi balandela yini imithetho.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika 1, lolu cwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi inqubomgomo ye-AI ekhiqizayo ilungile kuphela uma indlela ebhalwe ngayo ilungile: amanyuvesi abhala noma abuyekeza imithetho yawo ye-AI ekufundiseni nasekuhloleni kudingeka ahlole hhayi kuphela ukuthi umthetho uvumela yini, kodwa nendlela abafundi nabasebenzi abazoyifunda bazenze ngayo amagama ngawo uqobo.

arXiv preprint (University of Maryland and University of Iowa researchers) · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: How deeply students engage with an AI chat, not how often they use it, predicts better coursework, large Australian study finds
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi base-University of Queensland kanye ne-Monash University bafundela abafundi abayi-1,681 emakhosini ayi-40 amanyuvesi, abasebenzisa abalingani be-AI abakhelwe ekudaleni izinsiza, ekuhleleni ukubuyekeza komngani kanye nemisebenzi yokuzijwayeza. Ngokuhlaziya izingxoxo ezingu-829 ngokuzibandakanya kobuhlakani nokwakha imodeli yezinyathelo zomsebenzi ezingaba ngu-3,000, bathola ukuthi abafundi abazibandakanya ngokujulile ne-AI, kunokuba babe nje baxoxe nayo kaningi, bakhiqiza umsebenzi ogcinwe kahle, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphumelelanise imiyalezo emingaki. Ngemuva kokuphendula okungalungile, abafundi abaxoxile ne-AI benza imizamo embalwa elandela leyo, kodwa babe seqinisweni kakhulu uma bephinda bazama.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika 2, lokhu kubaluleke kunoma yisiphi isikhungo esakha ukuhlaziywa kwedatha ngokusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi e-AI: ukubala kaningi abafundi abavula i-chatbot akutsheli lutho oluningi ngokufunda, ngakho izinhlelo ezihloswe ukusekela impumelelo yabafundi kudingeka zibheke ubujulile bokuzibandakanya, hhayi inani lokuchofoza.

University of Queensland and Monash University (arXiv preprint, submitted to the Journal of Computer Assisted Learning) · Working paper (arXiv preprint, submitted to the Journal of Computer Assisted Learning)

entry.title: Grade the process, not just the AI-era output, Bristol pro vice-chancellor tells student success conference
entry.summary:
Ekhuluma emhlanganweni we-Student Success UK and Ireland owawuhlelwe yi-Times Higher Education, uTansy Jessop, iPhini likhansela elibhekele imfundo nabafundi e-University of Bristol, uthe amanyuvesi asedlulele ekubhekeni nje ukusetshenziswa okuvumelekile kwe-AI ekhiqizayo, kufanele kwakhelwe izivivinyo ezibonisa indlela umfundi afinyelele ngayo kuyimpendulo yakhe. Uchaze isibonelo esiphuma emnyangweni wesayensi yekhompyutha e-Bristol, lapho imisebenzi yokuklama amarobhothi ivamise ukuthi ibonakale ikhiqizwe nge-AI kuphela, okwaphoqa othisha ukuthi banikeze abafundi irobhothi eligcine ukwakhiwa, babacele ukuthi bachaze indlela elakhiwa ngayo. UJessop uthe le ndlela kufanele isize abafundi bakhe amakhono i-AI engeke iwathathele indawo kalula, kufaka phakathi ukufuna ulwazi, ukucabanga okujulile kanye nokubambisana.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika 1, lokhu kunikeza impendulo eqondile, esetshenziswa ngqo ekilasini, embuzweni wobuqotho bokuhlola: kunokuba amanyuvesi aqhubeke nokulandela amathuluzi okuthola i-AI angathembekile, kungenze izivivinyo ezenza ukucabanga komfundi kubonakale, futhi ezigcina umuntu uqobo njengofaka isandla ekwahluleleni.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: AI-generated 'slop' papers published under prominent academics' names without their consent
entry.summary:
Amamagazini amaningi afana nje ngokubukeka ashicilele amaphepha akhiqizwe yi-AI ngamagama abacwaningi abadumile, kuhlanganise no-Jure Leskovec kanye no-Fei-Fei Li base-Stanford, abathi abakaze babhale noma bathumele lemisebenzi. Ngokusho kwe-Times Higher Education, iphepha elinye laphinde lavela ngamagama omunye umbhali ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa selibikiwe futhi lisusiwe, futhi lamamagazini ahlanganyela umhleli omkhulu ofanayo nabanamalungu ebhodi angazi ukuthi afakwe kuwo. Lamamagazini amathathu, abhaliswe kuphela ngo-2026, akhokhisa ababhali phakathi kwamadola ayi-10 nama-200 ngephepha ngalinye.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika 6, lesi senzakalo sikhombisa indlela i-AI ekhiqizayo engasetshenziswa ngayo ukwenza amanga, hhayi kuphela imiphumela yocwaningo, kodwa nobunikazi babacwaningi uqobo, okuyinto okudinga ukuthi inqubomgomo ye-AI enokuzibophezela kwimfundo ephakeme inwetshwe ukufaka ubuqotho bokushicilela, ingagcini ekilasini.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Staff overestimate how much students use generative AI, Manchester study finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olwenziwe esikoleni esinye sesayensi yezenhlalo enyuvesithi yase-United Kingdom luthole ukuthi abafundisi basenyuvesi babukeza ngokweqile ukuthi abafundi basebenzisa kangakanani i-AI ekhiqizayo ezifundweni zabo. Ngokususela kuhlu lombuzo olwenziwe kubafundisi abangu-45 nabafundi abangu-86 e-University of Manchester, abafundisi balinganisela ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ngabafundi ku-5.23 kuzikali ezinamaphuzu ayisikhombisa, okuphezulu kakhulu kunesilinganiso sabafundi uqobo esingu-3.11. Abafundi babonakala futhi bathokozile kunabafundisi mayelana nezinzuzo ze-AI ekusebenzeni ngempumelelo nasekufundeni, futhi bathe bayisebenzisa ikakhulukazi ukuthola impendulo, ukuhlela umsebenzi obhaliwe nokulungisa uhlelo lwamagama.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika 1, umehluko phakathi kokubukezwa abafundisi nokwenziwa ngempela ngabafundi ukhombisa ukuthi inqubomgomo mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo kanye nokuklanywa kokufundisa kudinga ukusekelwa ubufakazi obuvela kubafundi uqobo, hhayi ukubukeza kwabafundisi, ikakhulukazi njengoba amanyuvesi amazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba abheka izinto ezifanayo.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Habit, not enjoyment, drives ChatGPT use among distance students at the University of South Africa, study of 294 finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olwenziwe kubafundi abangu-294 base-University of South Africa, isikhungo semfundo yamabanga amade esikhulu kunazo zonke e-Afrika, lusebenzise imodeli ye-UTAUT2 ukuhlola ukuthi kungani abafundi besebenzisa i-ChatGPT. Umkhuba wawungumbikezeli onamandla kakhulu kokubili wenhloso yokusebenzisa i-ChatGPT nokuyisebenzisa ngempela, ulandelwa yizimo ezisizayo njengokuqondiswa nezinsiza, kanti ukujabulela kanye nemibono yontanga akubanga namthelela obalulekile. Le modeli ichaza amaphesenti angu-69.2 enhloso yabafundi yokusebenzisa leli thuluzi namaphesenti angu-37.9 okulisebenzisa ngempela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika 1, ukuthola ukuthi umkhuba nokwesekwa yisikhungo, hhayi ubusha bento, yikho okuqhuba ukusetshenziswa kusikisela ukuthi amanyuvesi kufanele alolonge imikhuba yansuku zonke yabafundi nge-AI ngokuqondisa nangendlela izifundo ezakhiwe ngayo, ikakhulukazi emfundweni yamabanga amade emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Africa and Europe seek their own path on AI in science, with shared computing and genomic data on the agenda
entry.summary:
Emhlanganweni we-African Union ne-European Union mayelana ne-AI kwezesayensi mhla zingu-26 kuMfumfu, owabanjwa ku-inthanethi esikhundleni sokuba ube se-Addis Ababa njengoba bekuhleliwe, uMaria Cristina Russo, isikhulu esiphezulu se-European Commission, uthe i-United States ne-China zihamba phambili kakhulu nokuthi i-Europe ne-Afrika zidinga indlela yazo. Izikhulumi zacela amandla okucubungula idatha okwabelwana ngawo ezifundeni, uhlaka lwezwekazi lwedatha yofuzo nokwabelana ngezinzuzo, kanye nemigomo elinganisekayo yabesifazane, abacishe babe yingxenye eyodwa kwezinhlanu zabasebenzi bomhlaba kwezedatha ne-AI. Izincomo zizoyiswa emhlanganweni wongqongqoshe we-AU ne-EU wocwaningo nokusungula izinto ohlehliselwe ku-2027, kubika i-University World News.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika 6, lo mhlangano ubeka ubunikazi bedatha, ukufinyelela ngobulungiswa emandleni okucubungula kanye nokunyakaza kwamakhono enkabeni yenqubomgomo ye-AI, imibuzo ezonquma ukuthi amanyuvesi ase-Afrika ayayilolonga yini i-AI ocwaningweni noma ayayisebenzisa nje kuphela.

University World News · Established higher education press

entry.title: UNESCO: university enrolment in the Arab States has nearly tripled to almost 15 million, yet youth unemployment stands at 26%
entry.summary:
Umbiko omusha we-UNESCO, i-The state of higher education in the Arab States, uthola ukuthi inani labafundi abangena emanyuvesi kulesi sifunda seliphindeke cishe kathathu eminyakeni engu-25, lafinyelela cishe ezigidini ezingu-15 zabafundi, nakuba izinga lokubhalisa, elingamaphesenti angu-37 ngo-2024, lisesemuva kwesilinganiso somhlaba esingamaphesenti angu-44. Abesifazane manje sebeyingxenye cishe yabathweswe iziqu ze-STEM kulesi sifunda, uma kuqhathaniswa nengxenye engaphezudlwana kwesithathu emhlabeni, kodwa ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kwabasha kumi kumaphesenti angu-26, cishe kuphindwe kabili kunesilinganiso somhlaba. Lo mbiko, owethulwe e-Doha mhla zi-4 kuLwezi, uphakamisa izincomo eziyishumi futhi uphawula ukuthi amazwe ama-Arab angaphezu kwamaphesenti angu-70 asefaka izinhloso zedijithali ezinhlelweni zawo zikazwelonke zemfundo ephakeme.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika 5, lo mbiko ukhombisa lokho idatha yesifunda ngemfundo ephakeme engakwembula: ukwanda okukhulu kokufinyelela emfundweni akusho lutho uma izinhlelo zingalandeleli ukuthi abathweswe iziqu bayawuthola yini umsebenzi, inselelo efanayo neNingizimu Afrika namazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

UNESCO (IESALC and UNESCO Office Beirut) · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Deep Learning Indaba video: Vukosi Marivate on governing AI in Africa and what a degree is worth now
entry.summary:
Engxoxweni yemizuzu engu-36 eqoshwe ngesikhathi se-Deep Learning Indaba 2026 e-Pan-Atlantic University eLagos, uSolwazi Vukosi Marivate, ongomunye wabasunguli be-Indaba, i-Masakhane NLP ne-Lelapa AI, futhi ongomunye wochwepheshe abangu-40 be-United Nations Independent International Scientific Panel on AI, uchaza ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukweluleka ohulumeni nge-AI nokuthi kungani ukulawulwa kwe-AI eNingizimu Afrika kuthinta wonke umnyango kahulumeni. Uthi ukuzimela kusho amandla okuzenzela izinqumo, hhayi ukwakha konke ekhaya, ukuthi i-AI ayikuphulanga ukuhlolwa kodwa iveze ubuthakathaka bakho, nokuthi i-Afrika kufanele isuke ekuphumeni kochwepheshe iye ekujikelezeni kochwepheshe.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngesinsika 4, imibuzo yakhe mayelana nokuthi iziqu zibaluleke kangakanani esikhathini se-AI, nokuthi ingabe i-Afrika iqeqesha abasebenzi be-AI abashibhile ukuze basebenzele amanye amazwe, ithinta umongo wekhono labathweswe iziqu noguquko olunobulungiswa emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

Deep Learning Indaba (YouTube) · Africa's machine learning community, official video channel

entry.title: South Korea vows to prosecute students using AI glasses in exams
entry.summary:
UMnyango Wezemfundo waseNingizimu Korea uthi kusukela ngonyaka ozayo, uzophatha ukukhohlisa ku-exam kazwelonke yokungena enyuvesi ngokusebenzisa izibuko ze-AI njengecala lobugebengu, ngemva kokuba abafundi abathathu babanjwa bagqoke lezi zinsiza phakathi nokuhlolwa kokubhala emanyuvesi aseSeoul. Kusukela ngo-2027, labo ababanjwe bazovinjelwa ku-exam iminyaka emithathu, kuvela eminyakeni eyodwa, futhi abahloli bazobekwa kuzo zonke izikhungo zokuhlolwa ezingu-1,312 ukubheka izibuko ezisolisayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi amathuluzi e-AI ekhiqizayo aseshintsha ngokushesha kunemithetho yobuqotho bokuhlolwa emhlabeni jikelele (isinsika 1), futhi kukhumbuza ukuthi ukubona nokujezisa kuyingxenye kuphela yempendulo amanyuvesi nezinhlelo ezizoyidinga.

Times Higher Education · Established press

entry.title: AI Article Reviews Dominate Human Peer Reviews at Their Best: Evidence and Policy Choices
entry.summary:
Gary King noSteven Worthington be-Institute for Quantitative Social Science e-Harvard baqhathanise ukubuyekezwa kocwaningo okubhalwe yi-AI nokubuyekezwa kwabantu okungu-134 kwamamanuskripthi angu-124 aqoqwa phakathi kuka-2019 no-2026. Babika ukuthi ukubuyekezwa okwenziwe yi-Claude Opus 4.8 kwadlula ukubuyekezwa kwabantu kuzo zonke izilinganiso ezibakhile, kwathathwa njengokunembile kakhudlwana ekuhloleni kwabo, futhi kwathandwa abahleli bamajenali abadala abathathu kuningi lokuqhathaniswa okuqondile.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kuphonsa inselelo ngokucophelela futhi kusekelwe edathini kwindlela i-AI ekhiqizayo esetshenziswa ngayo ekwenzeni kwemfundo ephakeme, hhayi kuphela ekilasini (isinsika 1): uma i-AI ingakwazi ukubuyekeza ucwaningo kahle, amanyuvesi namajenali adinga inqubomgomo yokuthi isetshenziswa kanjani futhi nini, hhayi nje ukuyivala.

Institute for Quantitative Social Science, Harvard University · University working paper

entry.title: Proposal 14: Student outcomes indicators
entry.summary:
Umqondisi wemfundo ephakeme yaseNgilandi, i-Office for Students, uphakamisa ukushintsha isivinini esisodwa esiphumelele noma esihlulekile sokuqhubekela phambili kwabathweswe iziqu, usebenzise amanani amathathu alinganiselwayo e-Teaching Excellence Framework yakhe: ukuqhubeka ngomsebenzi noma ukufunda, imali abathweswe iziqu abayiholayo uma kuqhathaniswa namazinga ezwe lonke, nokuthi abathweswe iziqu bathi basebenzisa yini abakufundile, kusuka kumbuzo we-Graduate Outcomes survey. Lawa malinganiselo angaguqulwa ngomkhakha, indawo, iziqu zokungena kanye nezimo zomnotho nezenhlalo zabafundi, kunokusetshenziswa kwesilinganiso esisodwa esime ngqo kuzo zonke izifundo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kuvivinya ngqo umbuzo oyinhloko wesinsika 5: ukuthi uhlelo lwedatha olwakhiwe ngamalinganiselo amaningi, kunesilinganiso esisodwa esiqonde ngqo sezwe lonke, singakwazi yini ukwahlulela ngobulungiswa futhi kuthuthukise imiphumela yemfundo ephakeme.

Office for Students (OfS) · National regulator consultation

entry.title: UCT engineering pairs AI-enabled early warning with a multilingual support hub to lift student success
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi e-University of Cape Town, kuMnyango wobunjiniyela nokwakhiwa kwemvelo (Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment), bachaza iPhrojekthi Yempumelelo Yabafundi ehlanganisa uhlaka lokuhlola ubungozi kusenesikhathi, ukuqondiswa kwabafundi ngabafundi abadala, kanye nesikhungo sokusekela esisekelwe kudatha futhi sisebenzisa i-AI. Isikhungo lesi sihambisana nesichazamazwi sedijithali sezilimi eziningi ngesiXhosa, iSesotho, iKiswahili ne-Afrikaans, okubhekana nokucwaswa kwezilimi ndawonye nobungozi bokufunda. Lesi sahluko sivela kuConstellations of Hope, umbiko we-Club of Rome mayelana nokufunda okuguqulayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lesi yisibonelo esiqinisekisiwe futhi esiqondile saseNingizimu Afrika sokuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo empumelelweni yabafundi (insika 2), esakhelwe ekulinganeni kwezilimi; kukhombisa ukuthi idatha yesexwayiso sangaphambili isiza abafundi kuphela uma nosekelo olulandelayo lukhuluma ulimi lwabo.

Globethics Publications (Club of Rome report) · Peer-reviewed book chapter

entry.title: AI literacy alone does not create graduate opportunity, Nigerian study of 450 students finds; technology readiness is what matters
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwabafundi 450 bamanyuvesi eNigeria luveza ukuthi imfundo yobusomabhizinisi kanye nokufunda ngobuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) kokubili kukhuphula ukulungela kwabafundi kwezobuchwepheshe, futhi ukulungela lokhu yikho okubikezela ngqo ukuthi abafundi bazosebenzisa amathuluzi e-AI ukwakha amabhizinisi amancane ngempela noma cha. Ukubonakala kokuntuleka kwezinsiza kudobha ngqo isenzo sokusungula amabhizinisi sabathweswe iziqu, kodwa uma abafundi sebenazo izinsiza, lokhu kucacisa kakhudlwana ukuxhumana phakathi kokulungela nesenzo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lobu bufakazi obuqondile besika 4: ukufinyelela kuphela ku-AI akudali ithuba labathweswe iziqu endaweni ezinezinsiza ezincane; ukwakhiwa kwamakhono nokulungela kwezobuchwepheshe yikho okuphendula ukufunda i-AI kube izindlela zokuphila.

entry.title: Computational text indicators fail to improve, and can worsen, predictions of academic results, Salvadoran study warns
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi e-Universidad Salvadoreña Alberto Masferrer bahlola ukuthi izinkomba zombhalo ezivela ekufundeni kwemishini (machine learning), ezibonisa imikhuba yokuqonda yabafundi, zingakwazi yini ukwenza izibikezelo zemiphumela zezifundo zibe ngcono ngale kwedatha elula yekhaya nezinsiza. Kubafundi 263 ababhekwa izikhathi ezimbili ezindaweni ezinhlanu, izinkomba zekhompuyutha azizuzise lutho olubikezelekayo ngempela, futhi inye yazo yenza izibikezelo zaba zimbi kakhulu ngemuva kokulungiswa kokuqhathanisa okuningi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lesi isixwayiso esicacile kwinsika 5: izinkomba ezivela kumbhalo noma ukuziphatha ezenziwe nge-AI akufanele zithathwe njengezifanele ukusetshenziselwa izinqumo zemfundo eziyingozi ngaphandle kokuhlolwa okuqinile, umgomo i-Wits AHEAD eyisebenzisa emsebenzini wayo wokuhlaziya idatha.

entry.title: LMS activity, pacing and attendance are the strongest predictors of retention in blended courses, Turkish study finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olukujenali ethi Journal of Higher Education Policy and Management, olwenziwe ngu-İrfan Ayhan weKırşehir Ahi Evran University eTürkiye, luhlole indlela ukuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo, okususelwa emsebenzini wezinhlelo zokuphatha ukufunda, isivinini, ukuziphatha kokuhlolwa kanye nokuya esikoleni, okungakhomba abafundi abasengozini ezifundweni ezixubile zemfundo ephakeme. Luthola ukuthi lezi zibonakaliso ziyizona ezinamandla kakhulu ukubikezela ukugcinwa kwabafundi, futhi luphakamisa ukuthi, uma lusetshenziswa kahle, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo kungaqinisa izinhlelo zesexwayiso sangaphambili futhi kucacise amasu ezikhungo, uma nje izikhungo zinaka nokuziphatha kokusebenzisa idatha enjalo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kunsika kaWits AHEAD ye-AI nokuhlaziya kwedatha okubikezelayo ngempumelelo yabafundi, ucwaningo lukhumbuza ukuthi idatha esivele ikhona ezinhlelweni zokuphatha ukufunda zamanyuvesi amaningi, hhayi nje izinsiza ze-AI ezintsha, ingaqinisa isexwayiso sangaphambili esisebenzayo uma sihlanganiswa nohlaka olucacile lokuziphatha.

entry.title: Short hands-on workshop lifts science teachers' confidence in using AI for adaptive teaching, German pilot study finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo oluhlolayo oluphumele kujenali ethi Frontiers in Education, olwenziwa ngu-Mathea Brückner, u-Christoph Thyssen kanye no-Johannes Huwer bamanyuvesi aseKonstanz, i-Pädagogische Hochschule Thurgau kanye ne-Pädagogische Hochschule Freiburg, luhlole ukuthi iwekshofu emfushane, enezandla, ingakwazi ukunyusa ukuzethemba kothisha bezifundo zemfundo yesayensi ebangeni eliphansi lesekondari ekusebenziseni i-AI ekufundiseni okuguqukayo. Ocwaningweni olwenziwe ngothisha abangu-16 eJalimane ngesakhiwo sohlangothi olulodwa phambi nangemuva, kokubili ukubona kwabo ukuthi i-AI iwusizo kanye nokuzethemba kwabo ekuyisebenzisa kwenyuka ngokubalulekile ngemuva kweseshini, kanti lezi zilinganiso ezimbili zaqale kuphela ukuxhumana ngamandla ngemuva kwalokho. Ababhali baxwayisa ukuthi leli sampula elincane, elibikwa ngabo ngokwabo, likhombisa ushintsho, hhayi ukufakazela ukuthi iwekshofu yabangela ukuthuthuka okuhlala njalo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kunsika kaWits AHEAD ye-AI nokuhlaziya kwemfundo ye-STEM kanye nemfundo yothisha, ucwaningo lunikeza indlela eqondile, ebiza kancane, iwekshofu emfushane enezandla, enokuhlolwa futhi ifakwe izinhlelo zokuqeqesha othisha ukwakha ukuzethemba kothisha bezifundo zesayensi kuzinsiza ze-AI.

entry.title: World Bank video: 'small AI', not big models alone, can widen opportunity in developing-economy education and jobs
entry.summary:
Kumhlangano womhlaba wonke we-AI kanye nokwedijithali eSeoul, obuqoshwe yiWorld Bank Group, uMongameli wayo u-Ajay Banga wavula ingxoxo mayelana nendlela amathuluzi "e-AI encane" asebenzayo futhi avumelaniswe nezimo zendawo, hhayi kuphela amamodeli amakhulu avamile, angakwazi ukwandisa amathuba emnothweni osathuthuka. UNgqongqoshe wezokuXhumana, Ukusungula Kabusha Nomnotho Wedijithali waseNigeria, u-Bosun Tijani, wajoyina isikhulu esiphezulu se-Tridge u-Hoshik Shin kanye nomsunguli we-Amini u-Kate Kallot ukuxoxa ngemfundo, ezolimo kanye nezinsiza zomphakathi, kufaka phakathi ingxenye ekhuluma ngezifundo ezitholakele ekusetshenzisweni kwe-AI emfundweni eEl Salvador. Iqembu leli liphawule idatha yendawo ethembekile, ukuxhumana okuyinganekwane, amandla okubala, amakhono kanye nezinqubo zokuthenga njengezimo ezivumela abasunguli bendawo ukuthi bakhulise izixazululo zabo ze-AI.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini weWits AHEAD wensika ye-AI, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, lezi ingxoxo zibeka ithemba le-AI ezimweni ezisebenzayo, amakhono, ingqalasizinda kanye nokuthenga, okunqumayo ukuthi amanyuvesi nezinhlelo zasemazweni asathuthuka ziyazuza ngempela, kunokuba kuzuze kuphela abalingani babo abanemithombo eminingi eNyakatho yomhlaba.

entry.title: Review of generative AI ethics in higher education finds Africa only 11% of the evidence, calls for Ubuntu-informed governance
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olubuyekeza ngendlela ehlelekile olushicilelwe kuphephabhuku elithi Education Sciences, lubhalwe ngu-Pearl Yarkor Yarboi kanye nozakwabo baseYunivesithi yaseGhana, luhlole izifundo ezingu-246 ezishicilelwe phakathi kuka-2018 no-2025 mayelana nokuziphatha kwe-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, futhi luthole ukuthi amaziko ase-Afrika amele cishe amaphesenti ayi-11.4 kuphela kulolo lwazi, kuyilapho amaziko aseGhana amele amaphesenti ayi-2.8 kuphela. Luhlanganisa izinkinga eziphindaphindekayo kuzindikimba eziyisihlanu, ubuqotho bezemfundo, ukuphepha kanye nokuvikeleka kwedatha, ukubonakala nokuphendula, ukulingana nokufinyelela, kanye nokufunda nokuqonda i-AI, futhi lubika ukuthi amaziko aseGhana ikakhulukazi abonisa ukulawulwa okuhlelekile okulinganiselwe.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini weWits AHEAD we-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, isicelo socwaningo lwendlela yokuqonda eyahlukile futhi esekelwe ku-Ubuntu, kunokuba kube izindinganiso ezingeniswa ezivela eNyakatho yomhlaba, sikhuluma ngqo nendlela yeqembu ngqo mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme yase-Afrika.

Education Sciences · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Systematic review of 50 studies finds university AI governance works best when oversight, integrity rules and data risk are managed together
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olubuyekeza ngendlela ehlelekile olushicilelwe kuphephabhuku elithi Frontiers in Education, luholwa ngu-Fritz D. Bacalso kanye nozakwabo baseCebu Technological University ePhilippines, luhlole imirekhodi engu-221 ngokulandela inqubo ye-PRISMA 2020 futhi luhlanganise izifundo ezingu-50 mayelana nendlela amaziko emfundo ephakeme alawula i-AI ekhiqizayo ngayo. Luthola ukuthi ukwamukelwa okusebenzayo kuncike ekuvuthweni kokulawulwa: ukwengamela okuhlangene emayunithini amanyuvesi, izimiso ezicacile zobuqotho bezemfundo nokuvezwa kolwazi, kanye nokulawulwa kwedatha okususelwa ebungozini, kuhambisana nenzuzo yokusebenza kahle nokufunda uma ukusekelwa kwezemfundo kuhambisana nobuchwepheshe. Ucwaningo luphinde lubike igebe elikhulu phakathi kwezifunda, lucaphuna ucwaningo olunye lapho amanyuvesi ayisithupha aseNingizimu Afrika enezinqubomgomo ze-AI ezisemthethweni, kuyilapho akukho namanye amaziko ayisampula eGhana noma eNigeria enohlaka lokulawula olufinyelelekayo emphakathini.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini weWits AHEAD we-AI ekhiqizayo kuzifundo, ukuhlolwa kanye nobuqotho bezemfundo, lobu bufakazi bokuthi ukuvuthwa kokulawulwa, hhayi kuphela ukufinyelela emathuluzini, okunqumayo imiphumela kusekela isimo sokuthi amanyuvesi ase-Afrika akhe ukwengamela okuhlangene futhi okuhlanganisiwe, kunokuba kube nenqubomgomo ekhona kuphela ephepheni.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Systematic review proposes a two-part framework for generative AI and academic integrity in higher education
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olubuyekeza izincwadi ngendlela ehlelekile olushicilelwe kuphephabhuku elithi AI and Ethics, lubhalwe ngu-Batool Hendal no-Gobinda Chowdhury, luhlaziya okutholakele okungu-274 okukhiwe ocwaningweni olukhona mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, kuhlukaniswe ngezindikimba eziyisithupha, kuhlanganise izinzuzo nobungozi bayo, ukungathembeki kwamathuluzi okuhlonza umbhalo we-AI, kanye nezinqubomgomo nokulawulwa kwezikhungo. Kusuka kulobu bufakazi, ababhali baphakamisa Uhlaka Lokuvumelanisa Kwemfundo Ephakeme ne-AI Ekhiqizayo, oluncike ezinsikeni ezimbili, ukulawulwa nengqalasizinda ngasolunye uhlangothi, kanye nemfundo nokufunda nokuqonda i-AI ngalolunye, njengendlela esebenzayo yokusebenzisa i-AI ekhiqizayo ngendlela enesibopho kunokuba igqugquzele ukuqapha nje.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini weWits AHEAD we-AI ekhiqizayo kuzifundo, ukuhlolwa kanye nobuqotho bezemfundo, leli hlaka linikeza amanyuvesi ase-Afrika indlela eyinhlaka kunokugcina nje ukuqapha ngokuncike ekuhlonzweni, elakhiwe ebufakazini obuqoqiwe kunokuba ngolwazi lwesikhungo esisodwa.

entry.title: Mixed-methods study of 1,685 publications and 48 interviews finds generative AI is reshaping assessment, not just fuelling misconduct
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olusebenzisa izindlela ezixubile olushicilelwe kuphephabhuku elithi SN Social Sciences, lubhalwe ngu-Florieza M. Mangubat no-Fernando N. Mangubat, luhlanganisa ukuhlaziywa kwedatha yocwaningo kwemibhalo engu-1,685 eqoshiwe ku-Scopus mayelana nobuqotho bezemfundo nokuhlolwa, nezingxoxo nabafundi kanye nothisha abangu-48 ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme esifundeni saseCebu, ePhilippines. Luthola ukuthi ukunakwa kwezemfundo kule ndaba kukhule ngamandla ngemuva kuka-2022, ukuthi abafundi basebenzisa i-AI ekhiqizayo ukufunda nokwenza imisebenzi yezemfundo kodwa bavame ukungaqiniseki ukuthi yikuphi okubhekwa njengokusetshenziswa okwamukelekile, futhi ukuthi othisha baphendula ngokuguqula ukuhlolwa kuye ezindlela zokwenza okuqinisekile futhi okulandela inqubo, kunokuncika kuphela emathuluzini okuhlonza.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini weWits AHEAD we-AI ekhiqizayo kuzifundo, ukuhlolwa kanye nobuqotho bezemfundo, okutholakele kokuthi izikhungo kwenye ingxenye yomazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba zisuka ekuqapheni ziye ekuguquleni ukuhlolwa kuvumelana nalokho amanyuvesi ase-Afrika asebeke akucabangela, futhi kuqinisa umbono wokuthi ukuguqulwa kokuhlolwa kuyimpendulo ezoqhubeka kunokuhlonza nje.

SN Social Sciences · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Systematic review of 463 studies finds AI in Global South universities still mostly administrative, not pedagogical
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olucokisekileyo kanye nokuhlaziywa kwedatha yocwaningo olushicilelwe kuphephabhuku elithi Frontiers in Education, lubhalwe ngu-Nomfundo Gladys Khoza no-Freda van der Walt baseCentral University of Technology, eFree State, eNingizimu Afrika, luhlole imibhalo engu-947 futhi lufaka ucwaningo oluhloliwe ngochwepheshe oluyi-463, olushicilelwe phakathi kuka-2019 no-2025, mayelana nokufundisa okuthuthukiswe yi-AI kwimfundo ephakeme emazwenini aseNingizimu Yomhlaba. Luthola ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI kuseqondile ikakhulukazi ekusebenzeni kahle ngobuchwepheshe nemisebenzi yokuphatha, ukuthi ukufakwa kwe-AI ngempela kokufundisa kusalinganiselwe, futhi ukuthi ingqalasizinda engenele, ukungalingani kokufinyelela amathuluzi edijithali, ukungalungeli kahle kothisha kanye nokukhathazeka kokuziphatha kuyizithiyo eziyinhloko, kuyilapho izixazululo ezivumelanisiwe nendawo kanye nokusungula ngokubambisana ziyizona mathuba acacile.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini weWits AHEAD we-AI ekhiqizayo kuzifundo kanye nenqubomgomo ye-AI enesibopho nolingana, okutholakele kokuthi ukusetshenziswa kokuphatha kusalokhu kuphambili kunokusungula kokufundisa ngempela emazwenini aseNingizimu Yomhlaba kukhumbuza amanyuvesi ase-Afrika, kuhlanganise neWits, ukuthi kudingeka atshale imali ngamabomu ekulungiseleleni othisha kanye nezindlela zokufundisa ezivumelanisiwe nendawo, hhayi ukufinyelela kuphela amathuluzi e-AI.

entry.title: US universities race to launch AI majors as the count passes 100, nearly double in a year
entry.summary:
Amanyuvesi angaphezu kuka-100 aseMelika manje asenikeza iziqu zeBachelor kubuhlakani bokwenziwa phakathi kwemisebenzi yesayensi yamakhompiyutha, okuyinani eliphindwe kabili onyakeni owodwa, ngokusho kwesizindalwazi esigcinwa yiCentre for Inclusive Computing yaseNyuvesi yaseNortheastern. Iziqu ze-AI zaseNyuvesi yaseBentley zikhule kusukela kubafundi abambalwa lapho ziqalwa ngo-2024 ziyoba cishe ngu-100 kulonyaka, kuyilapho iziqu zeMIT zeAI and Decision Making, eziqalwa ngo-2022, ezimanje zingeziqu zesibili ezithandwa kakhulu enyuvesi, nabafundi abangu-354 ababhalisile. Abaphathi bathi lokhu kushesha kuphathelene nokukhathazeka kwabafundi ngemakethe yemisebenzi eguqulwe yi-AI kanye nesidingo sabaqashi sabaqeqeshwe ku-AI; ucwaningo lwaNhlaba luthole ukuthi okuphezu nencane kwesigamu sezikhungo ezingu-66 ezihloziwe ezinikeza iziqu ze-AI zidinga isifundo sokuziphatha.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngomsebenzi weWits AHEAD we-AI, amandla abathweswe iziqu, ukuqashwa nokuguquka olunobulungiswa, isilinganiso nesivinini sakhona lokuguquka eNyakatho Yomhlaba, kanye nesidingo esingafani sokuqeqeshwa kwezimiso zokuziphatha esihambisana nalo, kungesinye isibonelo iWits AHEAD engasisebenzisa ukucabanga indlela amanyuvesi aseAfrika angakwenza iziqu ze-AI ezifanele ngendlela yesibopho kunokuba ngokuphendula nje.

entry.title: Study combines AI-TPACK and Freire's critical pedagogy to rethink AI in African STEM curricula
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi ababili baseNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika (UNISA) bahlinzeka ngohlaka lombono wokufaka ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) ezinhlelweni zokufunda ze-STEM kulo lonke iAfrika, behlanganisa imodeli ye-AI-TPACK nefilosofi yokufundisa engokuhlaziya kaPaulo Freire. Ngokusekela ekubukeni kabanzi kwezincwadi kunokwenza ucwaningo olusha emabalazweni, iphepha lihlola amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokuqondisa ezihlakaniphile, amapulatifomu okufunda okuzivumelanisayo nokuhlolwa okuzenzakalelayo, liphakamisa ukuthi lawa angasiza ukwehlisa ingcindezi emakilasini agcwele futhi anezinsizakusebenza ezilinganiselwe. Liphakamisa amasu avumelana nesiko futhi asekelwe ezimisweni zokuziphatha, abhekana nezikhala zengqalasizinda, amandla othisha nokuhlukahluka kwezimo, ukuze ukwamukelwa kwe-AI kungakhulisi ukungalingani okukhona.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngomsebenzi weWits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI nokuhlaziya kwedatha ku-STEM nemfundo yothisha, leli phepha linikeza uhlaka oluphawulayo, olusekelwe eAfrika, lokulinganisa izithembiso ze-AI ekufundiseni i-STEM ngokumelene nezivimbelo zangempela zengqalasizinda kanye namandla othisha, okungaba isixwayiso esifanele sihlale sikhona ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho kushesheliswa ukwamukelwa kwe-AI.

entry.title: Survey finds most Built Environment students use AI chatbots but African universities still lack formal AI policy
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwabafundi be-Built Environment, olwethulwa eMhlanganweni we-FIG wango-2026 eKapa, luthole ukuthi amaphesenti angu-74 asebenzisa izinkulumo-mpendulo ze-AI ngokwemfundo, futhi anemibono eminingi emihle ngazo, kodwa libika ukuthi kukhona ukuqondiswa okuncane kwezikhungo. Ababhali, ababhala besezweni laseNamibia nelaseNigeria, baphawula ukuthi amanyuvesi ambalwa kuphela aseNingizimu Afrika, kuhlanganise iWits, iNyuvesi yaseKapa, iNyuvesi yasePitoli neNyuvesi yaseJohannesburg, enze izinqubomgomo ze-AI kusukela ngo-2024, kukhona amaphesenti angaphansi nje kwa-70 amanyuvesi aseMelika aseneminqubomgomo ye-AI ebhaliwe. Baphakamisa uhlaka lwenqubo lwamanyuvesi aseAfrika ukuba akhe izinqubomgomo zokulawula i-AI ezihambisana nezimo zawo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngensika yeWits AHEAD ye-AI enokuzibophezela, imithetho yokuziphatha, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, ukutholakala kokuthi iningi lezikhungo zaseAfrika zisengenayo inqubomgomo ye-AI esheshayo, nakuba abafundi basebenzisa izinkulumo-mpendulo ze-AI ngokubanzi, kukhombisa indlela ukuphathwa okusalele emuva kokwenzeka; uhlaka lweliphepha lunikeza isizinda sokuqala sokuvala leli gebe.

entry.title: WISE and Education Collaborative partner with five African universities on an AI adoption pilot
entry.summary:
I-WISE (i-World Innovation Summit for Education) ne-Education Collaborative yase-Ashesi University baqalise uhlelo lokuhlolwa lokusetshenziswa kwe-AI namanyuvesi amahlanu ase-Afrika: i-Bells University of Technology eNigeria, i-Botho University eBotswana, i-KCA University eKenya, i-University of Kigali eRwanda kanye ne-Université d'Abomey-Calavi eBenin. Kusukela ngoMfumfu 2026 kuya kuNhlangulana 2027, inyuvesi ngayinye izohlola iphrojekthi efanele izinto eziyigqugquzela, kusukela kubafundisi be-AI abahambisana nekharikhulumu nezinsiza zokufunda ezivumelana nezidingo, kuya ezinhlelweni zokuxwayisa kusenesikhathi nemithombo yokubusa yesikhungo. Lolu hlelo lususelwa kucwaningo lwesisekelo lwango-2025 olwahlola amanyuvesi angu-47 ase-Afrika, olwathola ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI akuhlangene kahle futhi ukubusa kusesebuthakathaka.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana nokubusa kwe-AI ngokunembeza, lolu kuhlolwa kwamazwe amaningi okuyingqayizivele kuhlola ngasikhathi sinye amathuluzi e-AI kanye nezinqubomgomo zesikhungo emanyuvesini amahlanu ase-Afrika ahluke kakhulu, okunikeza ubufakazi bokuqala bokuqhathanisa bokuthi ukusetshenziswa okunembeza kubukeka kanjani ngempela.

entry.title: Early success indicators at a South African university: a data-centric approach to student success
entry.summary:
Ongu Philokuhle Majozi noKgadi Mathabathe base-University of Pretoria baphakamise uhlaka olubizwa ngokuthi "izibonakaliso zempumelelo zokuqala," oluhlanganisa idatha nezinyathelo zokusekela kuwo wonke umjikelezo wempilo yomfundi, kusukela ngaphambi kokubhalisa kuze kuyokufika ekuhlolweni kokugcina. Ngokususelwa ezinhlolovweni nabaqeqeshi bempumelelo yezifundo, abaphathi bezikhungo kanye nosayensi bedatha, uhlaka luncamela indlela egxile emandleni nesebenza ngaphambili, kunokugxila kwamasistimu wokuxwayisa kusenesikhathi agxile ebuthakathakeni ababiza ngokuthi "basengcupheni."

entry.title: Cambridge-led OpRaise report: AI markers favour style over substance in university essays
entry.summary:
Abacwaningi bamanyuvesi e-Cambridge, i-Manchester Metropolitan ne-Nottingham bahlole amamodeli amathathu aphambili e-AI, ngayinye nangokuhlanganiswa, ku-essay 761 abafundi be-psychology e-undergraduate avela emanyuvesi amathathu e-UK. Amamodeli avumelana kakhulu phakathi kwawo, kodwa kancane nabahloli abangabantu, ehlala enika amamaki aphezulu umbhalo omude futhi oyinkimbinkimbi ngaphandle kokubheka izinga lokufunda, futhi amamaki abuthaniswa ophakathini kwesikali.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Njengoba i-Wits AHEAD icabangela indima ye-AI ekuhloleni, lobu bufakazi obuqinile, obuvela ezikhungweni ezahlukene, bukhombisa ukuthi ukumaka ngokuzenzakalela kusalokhu kugqugquzela indlela yokubhala kunokuqukethwe, okuyisixwayiso ngokuthi ungasebenzisi i-AI esikhundleni sokwahlulela komuntu emanyuvesi aseNingizimu yomhlaba, lapho amakilasi makhulu kakhulu futhi abahloli bambalwa.

University of Cambridge, Manchester Metropolitan University and the University of Nottingham (OpRaise project) · University research report

entry.title: World Bank video: Korea Partnership Facility forum explores AI for education and skills
entry.summary:
Isiteshi se-YouTube seWorld Bank Group sikhiphe ividiyo emfushane ngomhlangano wonyaka wezi-2026 we-Korea-World Bank Group Partnership Facility, lapho izikhulu zoMnyango wezoMnotho nezeZimali waseKorea, ochwepheshe be-World Bank kanye noSolwazi wase-KAIST baxoxa ngokuthi i-AI ingakwazi kanjani ukuqinisa ukufunda futhi ilungiselele abantu imisebenzi yangomuso. Le Facility ixhasa izinhlelo ze-AI nezamakhono edijithali emibusweni yezemfundo nemisebenzi emazweni asathuthuka.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ku-Pillar 4, lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi amabhange ezezimali emhlabeni manje asebuka ukuqeqeshwa kwamakhono e-AI njengokubalulekile ekuqashekeni kwabathweswe iziqu nokuguquka okunobulungiswa, hhayi njengokuthe ongezelelwe.

World Bank Group (YouTube) · International financial institution, official video channel

entry.title: Study finds South African universities' AI policies strong on student rules, thin on privacy and staff duties
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olubheka izinqubomgomo ze-AI ekhiqizayo ezishicilelwe amanyuvesi kahulumeni aseNingizimu Afrika luthola ukuthi ngesikhathi socwaningo, amanyuvesi angu-46 ekhulwini kuphela abe enenqubomgomo yesikhungo sonke. Lapho izinqubomgomo zikhona, zibeka imithetho ecacile mayelana nokucaciswa nokuphendulela kwabafundi, kodwa zibhekana nobumfihlo, ukuphathwa kwedatha nokuphendulela kwabasebenzi ngomfutho oncane, ikakhulukazi njengeseluleko hhayi njengemithetho ebophezelayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ku-Pillar 6, lobu bufakazi ngqo be-Wits AHEAD: ababhali bafuna izinqubomgomo zokuvumelana, ezakhelwe ukuvikela ubumfihlo kusukela ekuqaleni, okungukhona kuyinqo yokuphatha i-AI ngendlela enesibopho leli qembu elihlala lilandela.

Universal Access in the Information Society · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Smartphone AI tools help STEM teachers in low-resource African classrooms move beyond chalk and talk, study finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo olulandelayo oluholwa yiNyuvesi yesayensi yaseMalaysia (Universiti Sains Malaysia) lusebenzisane nothisha beSTEM abayishumi baseNigeria, Botswana, Ghana, Namibia naseSierra Leone ekhuphukeni okusebenzayo lapho kusetshenziswa amathuluzi e-AI okuguqula izwi libe yisithombe, ukuhlela ngamabhulokhi kusho ucingo lwesandla kanye nokulingisa izinhlelo zombani. Othisha bathi la mathuluzi enza izingqinamba zemfundiso yesayensi zibe lula ukubonisa, avumela abafundi abangenawo amakhompyutha asendleleni ukuthi bakhe amakhono okuhlela esicingweni, futhi abavumela ukuhlola izinhlelo zombani ngokuphepha ngaphambi kokuthinta izinsiza zangempela ezincane.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ku-Pillar 3, lobu bufakazi obuhle bokuthi amathuluzi e-AI akhethwe ngokucophelela futhi angabizi, hhayi izinsiza zamakhompyutha ezibiza kakhulu, yiwo angaguqula ukufundiswa kweSTEM emakilasini aseAfrika angenazo izinsiza ukusuka ekufundiseni kwenziwa ngesikhathi kuya ekuphenyeni kwangempela.

ECNU Review of Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Africa must build its own AI and data, not just adopt it, UFS tells QS Africa Forum
entry.summary:
Emhlanganweni we-QS Africa Forum 2026 e-Addis Ababa, uSolwazi Sam Tshehla, iPhini likaShansela e-University of the Free State (UFS), wathi engxoxweni mayelana nesidingo se-AI nekusasa lemfundo ephakeme ukuthi amanyuvesi ase-Afrika kumele ayeke ukusabela kuphela kwe-AI futhi akhe i-data namasistimu akhe awodwa akhombisa izilimi, amasiko kanye nezinto ezibalulekile zokuthuthuka zalo mzabalazo. Wathi i-AI ingasiza kuwo wonke uhambo lomfundi, kusukela ekwamukeleni kuya ekufundisweni nocwaningo, kodwa kuphela uma kukhona ukutshalwa kwezimali ekufundiseni ngobuchwepheshe bedijithali, ukuphathwa kanye nemigomo yokuziphatha.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini wePillar 6 mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, imigomo yokuziphatha, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, lesi sibizo sedatha namasistimu okungewe-Afrika sivumelana nokugcizelela kwa-Wits AHEAD kwemibono yokuphatha i-AI egxile endaweni, kunokungenisa kwamanye amazwe, emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

University of the Free State · University report

entry.title: AI exposure linked to 13 percentage point rise in top grades, Berkeley working paper finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha lokusebenza elibhalwe ngu-Igor Chirikov we-Center for Studies in Higher Education e-University of California, Berkeley, lihlaziya amamaki angaphezu kuka-500,000 anikezwa phakathi kuka-2018 no-2025 enyuvesi enkulu yocwaningo. Ezifundweni ezinemisebenzi eminingi yokubhala nokubhala ikhodi, ingxenye yamamaki aphezulu enyuke ngama-phesenti ayi-13 ngemva kokukhishwa kwe-ChatGPT, cishe amaphesenti ayi-30 ngaphezu kwesisekelo sango-2022, nokwenyuka okukhulu kwenzeka lapho umsebenzi wasekhaya ubalwa kakhulu emakini okugcina.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini wePillar 1 mayelana ne-AI ekhiqizayo ekufundiseni, ekuhlolweni nasekuthembekeni, lolu cwaningo luyisexwayiso sokuthi amamaki aphezulu akusho ukufunda okungcono: umsebenzi ka-Wits AHEAD wokubuyekeza ukuhlolwa kudinga ubheke leli ngozi efanayo emisebenzini yasekhaya.

Center for Studies in Higher Education, UC Berkeley · Working paper, University of California, Berkeley (CSHE)

entry.title: Generative AI closes three-quarters of the productivity gap between more and less educated workers, NBER study finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha lokusebenza le-National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), elibhalwe ngu-Guillermo Cruces, Diego Fernández Meijide, Sebastian Galiani, Ramiro H. Gálvez no-María Lombardi, libika ucwaningo oluhlelwe ngokungahleliwe kubantu abadala abangu-1 174 abenza umsebenzi wokuxazulula izinkinga zamabhizinisi. Ngaphandle kwe-AI ekhiqizayo, ababambiqhaza abane-mfundo ephakeme babenza ngcono kunalabo abanemfundo ephansi ngama-standard deviation angu-0.548; ngosizo lwe-AI, lo mehluko wancipha uya ku-0.139 standard deviation, okuvala cishe izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zomehluko wokuqala. Leli thuba lagcina kuphela ingxenye yalo ngesikhathi ithuluzi le-AI lisuswa emsebenzini olandelayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini we-Pillar 4 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana nekhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, lokhu okutholakele kunezinhlangothi ezimbili: i-AI ekhiqizayo ingancipha umehluko omdala wokusebenza kahle, kodwa leli thuba liphela uma kungekho umzamo oqhubekayo, ngakho izifundo kusamele zakhe ikhono eliyisisekelo elincike kuphela ku-AI.

National Bureau of Economic Research · Working paper, National Bureau of Economic Research

entry.title: World Bank warns AI's benefits in Africa could bypass the poorest households
entry.summary:
Umbiko we-World Bank, i-Africa Economic Update ka-October 2026, obizwa ngokuthi 'Building AI Readiness', ubikezela ukukhula komnotho e-Afrika esezansi kweSahara kusuka ku-4.1 wamaphesenti ngo-2025 kuya ku-4.3 wamaphesenti ngo-2026, lokhu kuqhutshwa ngokuyingxenye ukukhula okusheshayo kwemisebenzi yabaklami bezinhlelo zokusebenza: isixuku sabaklami bezinhlelo zokusebenza saseNigeria ku-GitHub sikhule kaplishumi kusukela ngo-2020, kanti esaseGhana sikhule phose kasishiyagalombili. Umbiko uphakamisa ukuthi i-AI ingakhulisa umsebenzi omningi futhi idale amathuba omsebenzi kulo lonke lesi sifunda, kodwa uthi ukusetshenziswa kwayo kusalingana ngokungafani futhi kugxile emazweni ambalwa, ikakhulukazi i-Kenya, i-Nigeria ne-South Africa. Ukhomba ugesi othembekile, ukuxhumeka kwe-inthanethi okungabizi, amakhono edijithali kanye namandla kahulumeni njengezimo ezisaswele kwingxenye enkulu yesifunda.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini we-Pillar 6 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, umbiko uyisexwayiso esicacile: amasistimu emfundo ephakeme emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba awakwazi ukucabanga ukuthi izinzuzo ze-AI zizofika zizenzekela; ukwakha amandla edijithali nawezikhungo oyisisekelo kusalokhu kuyimfuneko.

World Bank · Intergovernmental regional economic report

entry.title: Critical review finds Ghana's national AI strategy strong on readiness but thin on classroom detail
entry.summary:
Uhlaziyo oluphawulayo lwenqubomgomo, olwenziwe ngu-Matthew Nyaaba kanye nababhali-ndawonye abayisishiyagalolunye, luletha uhlaka lwenqubomgomo ye-AI olugxile kwezemfundo, futhi lusebenzise lona ohlakeni lwe-National Artificial Intelligence Strategy lwaseGhana lweminyaka ka-2025 kuya ku-2035. Ucwaningo luthola ukuthi inqubomgomo iqonde kahle ekufundiseni ngokuhlakanipha kwe-AI, amakhono entsha nokulungela komsebenzi, kodwa ayikathuthuki ngokwanele ekuzimeleni kothisha, ukuqeqeshwa kothisha ngaphambi kokusebenza, iziqondiso zohlelo lwezifundo nokuhlolwa, ukufundisa okusebenzisa izilimi eziningi futhi okuhambisana namasiko, kanye nokulawulwa okubandakanya izakhamizi emazingeni esikole. Ababhali bathi iGhana idinga uhlelo lokusebenzisa olugxile kwezemfundo, oluxhumanisa izinjongo zokulungela komsebenzi nokuqeqeshwa kothisha, ushintsho lohlelo lwezifundo kanye nokuvikelwa kwabafundi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Emsebenzini we-Pillar 6 ka-Wits AHEAD mayelana ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, lolu hlaziyo luyisikhumbuzo esiwusizo sokuthi izinqubomgomo zikazwelonke ze-AI emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba zivame ukushiya emuva umsebenzi osekilasini odingekayo ukuzenza zibe yiqiniso kothisha nabafundi.
